card.name: Dose amount before frequency phrase
card.fires_on: The unit word or space right after a dose amount (drop, mg, /kg, tablet) where a how-often phrase like twice a day, three times daily, or BID comes next. Seen in dosing schedules and tapers.

modes.label: Unit after amount
modes.description: The measure word after a number, just before a daily frequency.
modes.example: Days 4 to 6: 100 to 125<< mg>> twice a day.

modes.label: Drop or tablet before schedule
modes.description: The dosage form word in eye drop tapers or pill instructions, before a daily frequency.
modes.example: 1<< drop>> three times a day for the next

card.writes: It pushes toward yearly or per-year words and away from weekly and monthly words, which fits predicting a frequency of repetition.
card.plain: It marks the spot right after a dose amount where the text says how many times a day to take it.
